header: Here I decide what has been typed: a sum, a unit or currency conversion, a date question, a tyre size, a VIN, a BH number (all answered AS YOU TYPE, in the browser), or a request for a calculator form (opened with Enter). This file names no topic: it walks the topics of src/tools/registry.ts, each of which says in its own topic.ts which lines are its. I keep one strict gate, so that no ordinary search is ever taken for a calculation: a sentence about a circular, a person's name, a ticket number, a date on its own all give null. Privacy: a line that is a tool hit is never sent to the server's search, so a figure of someone's loan, pay or savings is not logged anywhere. (The currency rates come down as a public file; the amount stays in the browser.)

symbols.name: detectTool
symbols.sig: export function detectTool(raw: string, now?: DateTime): ToolHit | null
doc: Says what a typed line is: a tool hit, or null (an ordinary search). `now` fixes "today" for the tests.

behaviours: a sum is an expression
a unit conversion
a currency conversion is a currency question, not a unit one
a date question
the live kinds answer as you type, the forms and the menu wait for Enter
the PF loan page: emi, loan and pf-loan lines all open the provident fund page
the bank, car, home and society loan calculators are gone: those lines are no tool (they go to the ordinary search)
PF maturity form
gratuity needs a calculator word, and the other forms
a circular question that merely uses these words is NOT a tool
names, tickets, sites, departments and plain words are never a tool
nothing in the guide's existing samples is taken for a tool (no ordinary search is hijacked)
too short and too long are refused
detectForm says menu, a kind or null
the plural opens the converter like the singular: converters, Converters, unit converters, currency converters; a sentence that merely contains it stays a search
a tyre size is read as you type; 'tyre size' and 'ev charging' offer their forms; ordinary sentences stay searches
a wheel (rim) marking is read as you type: 8Jx20, with spaces, lower case, an offset, or a word like wheel in front
a bare 8x20 (it stays a sum), a wheel word alone, and ordinary sentences stay searches; 'wheel size' and 'rim specification' offer the tyre reader
a VIN is read as you type (17 valid characters), with a word like vin or chassis in front it is read even when incomplete; a lookalike or an ordinary line is not
'vin', 'vin number', 'vin decoder', 'chassis number' and 'vehicle identification number' offer the reader; a name like 'vin diesel' stays a search
a BH-series mark is read as you type, with or without spaces; an ordinary State mark or a sentence is not
'bh series', 'bharat series number plate', 'bh series road tax' and 'bharat number plate' offer the guide; 'bharat', 'bh' and 'bharat petroleum price list' stay searches
engine power: 'bhp to ps', '100 bhp', 'engine power' are live hits; a lone 'kw' is not
live data: gold, fuel, news, sports and markets are asked for in a few plain words
live data: the news line can ask for a language
the news card is found by the other ways of asking for it: 'news feed', 'newsfeed', 'news-feed', 'my news feed', 'newspaper', 'top stories', 'news ticker', 'what's the news'
a Hindi paper's NAME opens the Hindi tab: Dainik Bhaskar, Dainik Jagran, Amar Ujala, Navbharat Times (also 'nav bharat times'), 'hindustan news', 'hindi newspaper'
the other papers open their own tabs: Hindustan Times, Times of India, The Hindu (English); Economic Times, WSJ, The Hindu BusinessLine (Business); Anandabazar (Bengali)

a PART of a name is never the card: 'bhaskar', 'jagran', 'hindustan' alone, and 'bhaskar news', are searches for a person or a company; so are 'rss feed', 'feed the cat', 'hindustan zinc news', 'success stories', 'epaper'
live data: an ordinary sentence is never taken for it
live data answers as you type (no Enter), and is never searched
the sports card is found by 'sports news feed' and its like (feed, newsfeed, ticker, headlines, stories), while 'news feed' alone still opens the news card and a bare 'feed' opens nothing

the electric car window also opens for its specifications ('ev specifications', 'electric car battery specifications', 'ev specs explained', 'ev blade battery'), and ordinary lines about EV or specifications stay searches
